import asyncio

async def main():
    # read start.txt
    r = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "start.txt"})
    assert r["ok"], r
    first = r["data"]["text"].strip()
    path = first
    rows = []
    total = 0
    seen = set()
    for _ in range(2000):
        if path == "END" or path is None:
            break
        rr = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": path})
        if not rr["ok"]:
            return {"error": "read failed", "path": path, "receipt": rr}
        txt = rr["data"]["text"]
        fields = {}
        for line in txt.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or "=" not in line:
                continue
            k, v = line.split("=", 1)
            fields[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        val = int(fields["value"])
        rows.append((path, val))
        total += val
        if path in seen:
            return {"error": "loop", "rows": rows}
        seen.add(path)
        nxt = fields["left"] if val % 2 == 0 else fields["right"]
        path = nxt
    else:
        return {"error": "too long", "rows": rows}

    out_lines = [f"{p}\t{v}" for p, v in rows] + [f"TOTAL\t{total}"]
    text = "\n".join(out_lines) + "\n"

    w = await yuki_workspace_write({"path": "chain.tsv", "text": text})
    assert w["ok"], w

    rb = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "chain.tsv"})
    back = rb["data"]["text"]
    return {
        "rows": rows,
        "total": total,
        "expected": text,
        "readback": back,
        "match": back == text,
        "write_receipt": {k: w.get(k) for k in ("ok", "status", "data")},
        "read_version": rb["data"].get("version"),
    }

print(await main())
